purpose: Close Stage 4 by assembling the verified normal job tree and skill-acquisition outputs with awakening classification, display job stats, hero soldier modifiers, talent identity, and star-rank talent progression only after each semantic relation is explicitly verified.

heroInfo.note: Star is an explicit HeroInfo field, but it is not treated as star-rank talent progression without a verified relation.

jobConnectionInfo.note: TalentSkill_IDs is explicit and is preserved by Stage 4-4, but its role is not silently promoted to the complete hero talent/star progression model.

jobLevelInfo.note: Authoritative normal job-level skill acquisition edge already preserved by Stage 4-3/4-4.

semanticGates.requiredEvidence: An explicit ConfigData relation or client-code rule that identifies awakening skills. Do not classify by skill ID range, name, cost, wiki order, or being attached to an ultimate job.

Verified source/calculation for the hero-page HP/ATK/INT/DEF/MDEF/SKL display values, including PropertyModifyType meaning and any level/job/mastery calculation. BattlePower* names alone are insufficient.
Explicit relation for the hero-page soldier HP/ATK/DEF/MDEF modifier values. SoldierInfo base stats or training stats must not be substituted.
Verify how a playable hero selects its displayed normal talent from the TalentSkill-labelled relations and any other ConfigData/runtime relation.
Verify the source that maps hero star rank to the displayed talent description/value changes. HeroInfo.Star alone is not sufficient.

normalizationRules: Consume only Stage 4-3 and Stage 4-4 outputs whose status is PASS or REVIEW.
Use heroId as the only canonical hero join key.
Preserve Stage 4-3 job topology and Stage 4-4 acquisition order; Stage 4-5 must not rebuild or reorder them by names or numeric ID patterns.
Do not infer awakening from Skill ID, skill name, skill cost, job rank, IsUltimateJob(), or external wiki ordering.
Do not publish BattlePower* fields as hero display stats until the display-stat calculation is verified.
Do not substitute SoldierInfo base stats, TrainingTech values, or SP soldier values for hero soldier modifiers.
Do not equate HeroInfo.Star with talent star-progression data without a verified relation.
Do not equate JobConnectionInfo.TalentSkill_IDs with the complete displayed talent model until representative heroes verify the relation.
When a semantic gate is unresolved, keep its final field null/unemitted and block Stage 4 PASS instead of fabricating a value.

UPSTREAM_BLOCKED: Stage 4-3 or Stage 4-4 output is absent or has a status other than PASS/REVIEW.
SOURCE_BLOCKED: Any required TextAsset is missing, structurally invalid, or has no usable m_bytes payload.
SEMANTIC_BLOCKED: One or more Stage 4-5 semantic gates are not VERIFIED.
FAIL: Upstream hero sets disagree after both upstream stages are ready.
A referenced hero/job/skill record required by an already-verified Stage 4-5 mapping is missing.
Duplicate canonical IDs make a verified relation ambiguous.
PASS: Both upstream stages are usable, all required sources pass structural preflight, all five semantic gates are VERIFIED, and the final basic-combat record can be emitted without inferred relationships.

stage4CompletionRule: Stage 4 is data-complete only when Stage 4-5 returns PASS. Pipeline implementation alone does not mean the hero combat data is complete.
completionRule: After source replacement, run Stages 4-2 through 4-4, verify and promote every semantic gate in this contract to VERIFIED with evidence, then run npm run inspect:hero-combat. Do not bypass semantic gates merely because source files parse successfully.
nextStage: 5-1 bond data after Stage 4-5 PASS; Stage 5 pipeline work may be implemented earlier without falsely marking Stage 4 data complete.
